committee_name.text: Joint/combined advisory committee with representatives from the Reproductive Health Drugs Advisory Committee and the Oncologic (Oncology) Drugs Advisory Committee, plus experts in bone/osteoporosis, infectious diseases, dermatology, and epidemiology, convened to discuss all four denosumab indications.

quote.quote: Because all four indications were to be discussed, the Committee was comprised of some representative members from the Reproductive Health Advisory Committee and the Oncology Advisory Committee as well as experts in the fields of bone/osteoporosis, infectious diseases, dermatology and epidemiology.

meeting_date.text: August 13, 2009 (held during the first review cycle).

quote.quote: An Advisory Committee meeting was held during the first review cycle on August 13, 2009, to discuss the four biologic licensing applications/indications for denosumab.

recommendation.text: The committee voted unanimously to recommend approval of denosumab for the treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis.

quote.quote: The Advisory Committee voted unanimously for approval of denosumab for the indication "treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis."

linkages.concern: Many committee members felt the treatment population should be limited to patients at high risk of fracture until more long-term safety data are available.
linkages.change: The final approved indication was narrowed to postmenopausal women with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture (defined by prior osteoporotic fracture, multiple risk factors, or failure/intolerance of other therapy).

concern_quote.quote: Many committee members believed that limiting the treatment population to those at high risk of fracture was warranted until more data are available concerning long-term risks of therapy.

change_quote.quote: [TRADENAME] is indicated for the treatment of postmenopausal women with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture, defined as a history of osteoporotic fracture, or multiple risk factors for fracture; or patients who have failed or are intolerant to other available osteoporosis therapy.

linkages.concern: The majority of committee members believed a Medication Guide for patients and a Communication Plan to educate providers about the major safety concerns were warranted.
linkages.change: The approved REMS for Prolia includes a Medication Guide, a communication plan, and a timetable for submission of assessments.

concern_quote.quote: The majority of the Committee members believed that a Medication Guide to inform patients about the risks of the drug and a Communication Plan to educate providers about major safety concerns were warranted.

change_quote.quote: The REMS for this product includes a Medication Guide, a communication plan, and a timetable for submission of assessments.

summary: An advisory committee meeting was held on August 13, 2009 during the first review cycle to consider all four denosumab indications, combining members from the Reproductive Health and Oncology advisory committees plus outside experts; it reviewed safety concerns including serious infection, new malignancies, bone over-suppression (ONJ, atypical fracture, delayed healing), and dermatologic events. The committee voted unanimously to recommend approval for treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis. Committee sentiment that the population be limited to high-risk patients is reflected in the narrowed final indication (high risk for fracture), and its support for a Medication Guide and provider communication plan aligns with the REMS that was required, though the review attributes the REMS/indication decisions to the Division and OSE rather than explicitly to the committee.
